title: Audit evals-from-sessions for reuse and safety
description: Read (never run) github.com/ibragim-bad/evals-from-sessions. Decide: use as-is, borrow pieces (episode detection, repo snapshot w/o future history, nop/oracle/near-miss verification), or skip. Check data egress + secret scanning, supported session formats (Codex, Claude, Hermes sqlite, omp), non-coding task support.
notes: Audited github.com/ibragim-bad/evals-from-sessions @4e85a197 (v1.0.4, MIT, 883 lines). SAFETY: clean. It is a SKILL.md methodology + Harbor task template + leak-probe.sh (docker build, run --network none, grep). No network calls, telemetry or uploads. Only exposure: whatever model runs the skill reads the transcripts. REUSE: no mining code at all (explicitly 'no parsers; read JSONL with jq'), so our miner is still needed (Hermes sqlite, omp not covered). Adopt: task template (Dockerfile re-init single commit, hidden tests, test.sh always writes reward), leak-probe.sh, validation protocol (nop 0, oracle 5/5, one near-miss mutant per failure mode, alt-correct, leak check, harbor check, smoke, please-hack), provenance.md spec freeze + 2 checkpoints, discovery/routine labels, closed-set JSON answers for investigative tasks, network allowlist for public-code-derived repos (sd-scripts, hcom are public upstreams!). GAPS: rejects ungradeable/discussion/GPU/'user said OK' episodes; single-turn only; binary reward only; heavy per-task cost.
close_reason: Audit done: safe; adopt methodology+template, build own miner and non-coding/multi-turn/scoring layers

title: Mine review passes that found real bugs as task evidence
description: User idea: reviews (review-mcp review_with_context calls, reviewer/verifier subagent threads, hcom reviews) that found actual bugs, followed by a fix, are confirmed model errors with a reference fix. Extract review calls + outputs, detect findings that led to a fix (later edits/commits touching the flagged code, or classifier verdict), and surface them as high-priority candidates linked to the episode that introduced the bug.
notes:
Survey 2026-11-17: ~640 review-mcp review_with_context calls in Codex history (sd-scripts 232, hcom 89, data-processing 84, pytortch 20) + 11 adversarial_reviewer subagent threads. review-mcp saves reviews only to /tmp/review-mcp-run-*/review.md (15 survive) -> must extract from Codex transcripts: older sessions call review_with_context directly (function_call_output = {result: markdown}); newer ones call tools.mcp__review_mcp__review_with_context inside code-mode exec, output multiplexed in chunks. Reviews are free-text markdown (Summary/Strengths/Observations/Findings). Plan: extract review result + agent's next message + following tool calls; GLM (thinking on) labels real_bug_fixed / false_positive / no_findings / minor_only; real_bug_fixed -> candidate with pre-fix commit and fix as reference.
User 2026-11-17: in data-processing, hermes-agora, and later pytortch-backend and sd-scripts, reviews ran as NATIVE subagents (Claude Code with GLM/Claude, omp), not review-mcp. Survey: 133 review/audit/verify Agent-tool calls in Claude parent transcripts (pytortch 79, sd-scripts 28, hermes-agora 14, data-processing 11); the subagent's final report is the Agent tool_result in the parent transcript, so parent transcripts suffice. omp: 38 data-processing sessions with task/review tool calls (64 omp jsonl incl. subagent files). Sources to extract: review-mcp results (Codex), Claude Agent results, omp task results, Codex adversarial_reviewer threads.
2026-11-17: extractor done (fr reviews): 619 usable reviews in priority repos, 412 followed by edits. Not yet: omp task-based reviews (data-processing), GLM labelling real_bug_fixed/false_positive/no_findings/minor_only.

title: Classify episode follow-ups with GLM (model error vs misunderstanding)
description: Replace keyword correction flags with a GLM 5.3 Flash classification of each follow-up (model_error, misunderstanding, scope_change, question, acknowledgement), given the assistant message before and after. User's pushback is sometimes their own misunderstanding, so model_error is what ranks candidates. Cache labels; validate against ~50 user labels before relying on it.

title: Explore non-llama.cpp local backends for serving profiles
description: User may run local models on backends other than llama.cpp. Find out whether llama-swap can front them (its model cmd launches any OpenAI-compatible server? docker-run vLLM/SGLang/exllama/TabbyAPI?), how health checks, ports and unload work, and how a serving profile should record the backend. Do this when the first non-llama.cpp model is set up. Outcome: serving-profile format and fr serve support for that backend, docs/serving.md.
